matrix.name: All 17 candidates and all three Javid videos remain available with learning titles and levels
Library works at seven widths with keyboard-reachable 44px Watch actions and no overflow
A single library Watch action loads the selected default, without a redundant Load action
Replay and endpoint enforcement use absolute proposed boundaries, never lesson completion
Return to practice pauses, removes the frame and focuses the visible physical exercise
Deep link, reload and URL watch hints never auto-load; every candidate Watch uses its evidence-based default
Watch and owner-mode navigation work by keyboard with accurate disclosure state
Mapped lesson step chooses Louise’s relevant chapter rather than unrelated introduction
Chapter switching, outside-window seeking and replay restore correct bounds on the same player
Owner review is a separate explicit mode; learner view contains no timestamps form, export or caption settings
Caption preference requests remain in owner mode and preserve selected boundaries
Private review saves and exports explicit observations; never grants approval or leaks account identity
Seven responsive player widths meet 200×200, and mobile first viewport exposes Watch with no technical form
Short viewport, keyboard focus and enlarged-text reflow retain reachable practice and player actions
Topic and experience filters retain all candidates and avoid unrelated step claims
Café conflict and Louise start-only stay unverified; unseen content is labelled suggested focus
Provider restriction and failed API connection preserve written practice and offer retry or original
Continue lesson resumes existing step and checklist, with no learning writes from video playback
Route cleanup pauses/destroys the player, and returning to Learn does not start background playback
Unknown candidate is not silently substituted and never loads a player
Invalid private review data remains untouched outside owner mode; explicit recovery keeps learning
Failed owner save is truthful and exportable, with learner progress unchanged
